verdict.rationale: The evidence shows users control where data lives. Self-hosted Docker writes to a user-mounted local storage volume, and Private Cloud runs on any Kubernetes cluster. The API is described as letting users 'store, search, and manage points', and a production user reports 'lots of daily inserts/deletions', so deleting data works in practice. However, no first-party evidence documents a delete API, retention policies, or TTLs. missing for 10: documented point/collection deletion API, automatic retention/TTL policies, guarantees on purging deleted data (including from snapshots), and managed-cloud retention terms.
